Thus has the glory of Mount Veṅkaṭācala been related, O goddess. (25)
Whoever constantly hears this, and whoever recites it,
freed from all sin, goes to the world of Viṣṇu. (26)
Thus was this spoken long ago by the great-souled Vyāsa himself;
whoever hears it or reads it will have accomplished his purpose. (27)

2.1.s: tasyaiva vaṃśajāḥ sarve muktiṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ .. 28 .. ..
2.1.d: तस्यैव वंशजाः सर्वे मुक्तिं यान्ति न संशयः .. 28 .. ..
2.1.m: All born in his lineage attain liberation, there is no doubt. (28)

2.1.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye'ñjanāvaralabdhyākāśagaṃgā snānakālanirṇayādivarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 40 ..
2.1.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां द्वितीये वैष्णवखण्डे श्रीवेंकटाचलमाहात्म्येऽञ्जनावरलब्ध्याकाशगंगा स्नानकालनिर्णयादिवर्णनंनाम चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 40 ..
2.1.m: Thus ends the fortieth chapter, named 'Description of the Acquisition of the Boon by Añjanā, Determination of the Time for Ablution in the Ākāśagaṅgā, etc.,' in the glorious Veṅkaṭācalamāhātmya, in the second Vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. (40)
Thus ends the glorious Veṅkaṭācalamāhātmya contained within the Skandapurāṇa.

2.1.s: devanāgarī yunikoḍa rūpāntaraṇa – 13-9-2015ī.(bhādrapada kṛṣṇa amāvāsyā, vikrama saṃvat 2072)
2.1.d: देवनागरी युनिकोड रूपान्तरण – 13-9-2015ई.(भाद्रपद कृष्ण अमावास्या, विक्रम संवत् 2072)
2.1.m: Devanāgarī Unicode transcription — 13-09-2015 CE (Bhādrapada dark fortnight, new moon day, Vikrama Saṃvat 2072).
Now, the first [part] in the Vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍa: the Veṅkaṭācalamāhātmya (2.1).

2.1.s: 1 sūtaśaunakasaṃvāde nāradasya sumeruśikharasthayajñavarāhadarśanam, tataḥ svāmipuṣkariṇyāḥ sarvatīrthātiśāyitvavarṇanam, kumāradhārāmāhātmyam, tuṃbatīrthamāhātmyam, pāṇḍavatīrthamāhātmyam, pāpanāśana-devatīrthayormāhātmyam, dharaṇīkṛtavarāhastutiḥ, varāhasya dharaṇyā sākaṃ śeṣācalaṃ pratyāgamanama, veṅkaṭācalamāhātmyaśravaṇāvasaraḥ, adhyāyaphalaśrutiḥ.. 1
2.1.d: 1 सूतशौनकसंवादे नारदस्य सुमेरुशिखरस्थयज्ञवराहदर्शनम्, ततः स्वामिपुष्करिण्याः सर्वतीर्थातिशायित्ववर्णनम्, कुमारधारामाहात्म्यम्, तुंबतीर्थमाहात्म्यम्, पाण्डवतीर्थमाहात्म्यम्, पापनाशन-देवतीर्थयोर्माहात्म्यम्, धरणीकृतवराहस्तुतिः, वराहस्य धरण्या साकं शेषाचलं प्रत्यागमनम, वेङ्कटाचलमाहात्म्यश्रवणावसरः, अध्यायफलश्रुतिः.. 1
2.1.m: 1. In the dialogue between Sūta and Śaunaka: Nārada's vision of Yajñavarāha situated on the summit of Mount Sumeru; then, the description of Svāmipuṣkariṇī's superiority over all sacred fords; the māhātmya of Kumāradhārā; the māhātmya of Tuṃbatīrtha; the māhātmya of Pāṇḍavatīrtha; the māhātmya of Pāpanāśana and Devatīrtha; the hymn of praise to Varāha offered by Dharaṇī; Varāha's return to Śeṣācala together with Dharaṇī; the occasion for hearing the Veṅkaṭācalamāhātmya; the statement of fruits of the chapter. [1]
2. The rite of worship with the mantra of Varāha. [4]

2.1.s: 3 athāgastyaprārthanayā bhagavataḥ sarvajanadṛggocaratvavarṇanam, tato mitravarmaṇa ākāśarājākhyasutotpattivarṇanam, dharaṇītalātpadmāvatyutpattikramaḥ, ākāśarājasya dharaṇyākhyapatnyāṃ vasudānākhyasutotpattiḥ.... 4
2.1.d: 3 अथागस्त्यप्रार्थनया भगवतः सर्वजनदृग्गोचरत्ववर्णनम्, ततो मित्रवर्मण आकाशराजाख्यसुतोत्पत्तिवर्णनम्, धरणीतलात्पद्मावत्युत्पत्तिक्रमः, आकाशराजस्य धरण्याख्यपत्न्यां वसुदानाख्यसुतोत्पत्तिः.... 4
2.1.m: 3. Now, the description of the Lord becoming visible to the eyes of all people upon Agastya's prayer; then, the description of the birth of the son named Ākāśarāja to Mitravarman; the manner of the emergence of Padmāvatī from the surface of the earth; the birth of the son named Vasudāna to Ākāśarāja through his wife named Dharaṇī. [4]

2.1.s: 4 udyānavāsinyāḥ padmāvatyāḥ samīpe nāradāgamanam, nāradodīritapadmāvatīśarīralakṣaṇāni, padmāvatyāḥ svasakhībhiḥ sākaṃ puppāṭavīgamanam, mṛgayārthaṃ puppāṭavīṃ prati śrīnivāsāgamanam , bhagavataḥ kanyakānāṃ cānyonyasaṃvādaḥ 5
2.1.d: 4 उद्यानवासिन्याः पद्मावत्याः समीपे नारदागमनम्, नारदोदीरितपद्मावतीशरीरलक्षणानि, पद्मावत्याः स्वसखीभिः साकं पुप्पाटवीगमनम्, मृगयार्थं पुप्पाटवीं प्रति श्रीनिवासागमनम् , भगवतः कन्यकानां चान्योन्यसंवादः 5
2.1.m: 4. Nārada's arrival near Padmāvatī, who was staying in the pleasure-garden; the physical marks of Padmāvatī described by Nārada; Padmāvatī's going to the Puppāṭavī forest together with her female companions; Śrīnivāsa's arrival at the Puppāṭavī forest for hunting; and the mutual conversation between the Lord and the maidens. [5]

2.1.s: 5 atha padmāvatīdarśanena śrīnivāsasya mohaprāptiḥ, muhyamānaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ prati bakulamālikoktiḥ, śrīnivāsoktapadmāvatīpariṇayakāraṇāni, viyadrājapuraṃ prati bakulamālikāgamanam, divyodyānasthapadmāvatasakhīḥ prati bakulamālikoktiḥ.. 7
2.1.d: 5 अथ पद्मावतीदर्शनेन श्रीनिवासस्य मोहप्राप्तिः, मुह्यमानं श्रीनिवासं प्रति बकुलमालिकोक्तिः, श्रीनिवासोक्तपद्मावतीपरिणयकारणानि, वियद्राजपुरं प्रति बकुलमालिकागमनम्, दिव्योद्यानस्थपद्मावतसखीः प्रति बकुलमालिकोक्तिः.. 7
2.1.m: 5. Now, Śrīnivāsa's falling into infatuation upon seeing Padmāvatī; Bakulamālikā's speech to the infatuated Śrīnivāsa; the reasons for the marriage with Padmāvatī stated by Śrīnivāsa; Bakulamālikā's going to the city of Viyadrāja; Bakulamālikā's speech to the companions of Padmāvatī situated in the celestial pleasure-garden. [7]

2.1.s: 6 atha bakulamālikāṃ prati sakhīviniveditapadmāvatyudantaḥ, padmāvatīmuddiśya daivajñaṃ prati viyadrājakṛtapraśnādiḥ- daivajñoktyā'gastyaliṃgārcanāya viprādipreṣaṇam, dharaṇīkṛtapraśnasya pulindinīprativacanam ,padmāvatīniveditabhagavadbhāgavatayorlakṣaṇāni, bakulamālikayā sārdhaṃ sakhīnāṃ dharaṇīsamīpa āgamanam. 8
2.1.d: 6 अथ बकुलमालिकां प्रति सखीविनिवेदितपद्मावत्युदन्तः, पद्मावतीमुद्दिश्य दैवज्ञं प्रति वियद्राजकृतप्रश्नादिः- दैवज्ञोक्त्याऽगस्त्यलिंगार्चनाय विप्रादिप्रेषणम्, धरणीकृतप्रश्नस्य पुलिन्दिनीप्रतिवचनम् ,पद्मावतीनिवेदितभगवद्भागवतयोर्लक्षणानि, बकुलमालिकया सार्धं सखीनां धरणीसमीप आगमनम्. 8
2.1.m: 6. Now, the news of Padmāvatī communicated by the companions to Bakulamālikā; the inquiry made by Viyadrāja to the astrologer concerning Padmāvatī; the sending of brahmins and others to worship the liṅga of Agastya upon the word of the astrologer; the reply of the Pulinda woman to the question asked by Dharaṇī; the characteristics of the Lord and His devotee described by Padmāvatī; the arrival of the companions before Dharaṇī along with Bakulamālikā. [8]

2.1.s: 7 dharaṇīdevyai bakulamālikāniveditaśrīnivāsodanta:, śrīnivāsoktyā śaṃkhanṛpasya svāmitīrthe tapaḥkaraṇam, bakulamālikoktyā dharaṇyādikṛtavivāhaniścayaḥ, viśvakarmakṛtapurālaṃkārādikramaḥ, śukreṇa saha bakulāyāḥ śrīnivāsasamīpe gamanam., śrīnivāsāyai śukāveditapadmāvatīpariṇayavṛttāntaḥ, padmāvatyāḥ śukadatta - śrīnivāsamālādhāraṇam --- --- --- --- --- ---
2.1.d: 7 धरणीदेव्यै बकुलमालिकानिवेदितश्रीनिवासोदन्त:, श्रीनिवासोक्त्या शंखनृपस्य स्वामितीर्थे तपःकरणम्, बकुलमालिकोक्त्या धरण्यादिकृतविवाहनिश्चयः, विश्वकर्मकृतपुरालंकारादिक्रमः, शुक्रेण सह बकुलायाः श्रीनिवाससमीपे गमनम्., श्रीनिवासायै शुकावेदितपद्मावतीपरिणयवृत्तान्तः, पद्मावत्याः शुकदत्त - श्रीनिवासमालाधारणम् --- --- --- --- --- ---
2.1.m: 7. The news of Śrīnivāsa communicated by Bakulamālikā to queen Dharaṇī; King Śaṅkha's performance of austerity at Svāmitīrtha on the word of Śrīnivāsa; the decision regarding the marriage made by Dharaṇī and others upon the word of Bakulamālikā; the order of the embellishment of the city and other tasks performed by Viśvakarman; Bakulā's going to the presence of Śrīnivāsa along with Śukra; the account of the marriage with Padmāvatī reported to Śrīnivāsa by Śuka; Padmāvatī's wearing of the garland of Śrīnivāsa given by Śuka. [...]

2.1.s: 8 atha śrīnivāsasya lakṣmyādikṛtapariṇayālaṃkāra:, brahmādibhiḥ sākaṃ śrīnivāsasya viyadrājapuragamanam vadhūvarayorviyadrājavitīrṇaprābhṛtādikam , śrīnivāsakṛpayā viyadrājasya bhaktirūpavaraprāpti:, vivāhārthamāgatānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ svavāsagamanam.
2.1.d: 8 अथ श्रीनिवासस्य लक्ष्म्यादिकृतपरिणयालंकार:, ब्रह्मादिभिः साकं श्रीनिवासस्य वियद्राजपुरगमनम् वधूवरयोर्वियद्राजवितीर्णप्राभृतादिकम् , श्रीनिवासकृपया वियद्राजस्य भक्तिरूपवरप्राप्ति:, विवाहार्थमागतानां ब्रह्मादीनां स्ववासगमनम्.
2.1.m: 8. Now, the marriage-adornment of Śrīnivāsa performed by Lakṣmī and others; Śrīnivāsa's going to the city of Viyadrāja together with Brahmā and others; gifts and presents presented by Viyadrāja to the bride and groom; Viyadrāja's attainment of the boon of devotion by the grace of Śrīnivāsa; the departure of Brahmā and the other gods who had arrived for the wedding back to their own abodes.

2.1.s: 9 atha vasu nāmakaniṣādavṛttāntaḥ, sutahananodyuktaṃ vasuṃ prati bhagavadukti:, raṃgadāsasya śrīnivāsasevāyai śrīśeṣācalāgamanam, śrīnivāsārthaṃ raṃgadāsakṛtadivyodyānamaṇḍapādinirmāṇāni, raṃgadāsasya gaṃdharvakrīḍādarśanena bhagavatkaiṃkaryavismṛtiḥ, svarūpānusaṃdhānena lajjitaṃ raṃgadāsaṃ prati śrīnivāsavacanam , toṇḍamānnāmakanṛpavṛttānta:, tasya mṛgayārthaṃ śrīśeṣācalagamanam , śrīnivāsasamīpasthapañcavarṇaśukavṛttāntaḥ, toṇḍamānnṛpasya niṣādena saha śrīnivāsasamīpagamanam , toṇḍamānnṛpaṃ prati reṇukokti:, devādikṛtaśrīlakṣmīstuti:, --- --- - - -
2.1.d: 9 अथ वसु नामकनिषादवृत्तान्तः, सुतहननोद्युक्तं वसुं प्रति भगवदुक्ति:, रंगदासस्य श्रीनिवाससेवायै श्रीशेषाचलागमनम्, श्रीनिवासार्थं रंगदासकृतदिव्योद्यानमण्डपादिनिर्माणानि, रंगदासस्य गंधर्वक्रीडादर्शनेन भगवत्कैंकर्यविस्मृतिः, स्वरूपानुसंधानेन लज्जितं रंगदासं प्रति श्रीनिवासवचनम् , तोण्डमान्नामकनृपवृत्तान्त:, तस्य मृगयार्थं श्रीशेषाचलगमनम् , श्रीनिवाससमीपस्थपञ्चवर्णशुकवृत्तान्तः, तोण्डमान्नृपस्य निषादेन सह श्रीनिवाससमीपगमनम् , तोण्डमान्नृपं प्रति रेणुकोक्ति:, देवादिकृतश्रीलक्ष्मीस्तुति:, --- --- - - -
2.1.m: 9. Now, the account of the Niṣāda named Vasu; the speech of the Lord to Vasu who was intent on killing his son; Raṅgadāsa's arrival at Śrīśeṣācala for the service of Śrīnivāsa; the construction of the celestial garden, pavilion, and other structures made by Raṅgadāsa for Śrīnivāsa; Raṅgadāsa's forgetfulness of the Lord's service upon seeing the play of Gandharvas; the word of Śrīnivāsa to Raṅgadāsa, who was ashamed upon reflecting on his true nature; the account of the king named Toṇḍamān; his going to Śrīśeṣācala for hunting; the account of the five-colored parrot in the vicinity of Śrīnivāsa; King Toṇḍamān's going to the vicinity of Śrīnivāsa along with the Niṣāda; Reṇukā's speech to King Toṇḍamān; the hymn of praise to Śrī Lakṣmī made by the gods and others. [...]

2.1.s: 10 atha toṃḍamānnṛpasya svapituḥ sakāśādrājyaprāptiḥ, toṇḍamānnṛpāya vasuniveditavārāhodantaḥ, nṛpasya niṣādavākyasvapnābhyāṃ bilamāgeṃṇa śeṣācalagamanam , bhagavaduktyā toṇḍamānnṛpakṛtakṣīrābhiṣekavapranirmāṇādikam , asthisarovaramāhātmyam, kurvadhāmasthakulālavaṃśajabhīmākhyabhaktodantaḥ kurvadhāmasthabhīmākhyabhaktasya patnyā saha vaikuṇṭhaprāptiḥ, śrīnivāsakṛpayā toṃḍamānnṛpasya sārūpyaprāptiḥ, etanmāhātmya paṭhanaśravaṇaphalaśrutiḥ ... - - - - - - - - --- --- ---
2.1.d: 10 अथ तोंडमान्नृपस्य स्वपितुः सकाशाद्राज्यप्राप्तिः, तोण्डमान्नृपाय वसुनिवेदितवाराहोदन्तः, नृपस्य निषादवाक्यस्वप्नाभ्यां बिलमागेंण शेषाचलगमनम् , भगवदुक्त्या तोण्डमान्नृपकृतक्षीराभिषेकवप्रनिर्माणादिकम् , अस्थिसरोवरमाहात्म्यम्, कुर्वधामस्थकुलालवंशजभीमाख्यभक्तोदन्तः कुर्वधामस्थभीमाख्यभक्तस्य पत्न्या सह वैकुण्ठप्राप्तिः, श्रीनिवासकृपया तोंडमान्नृपस्य सारूप्यप्राप्तिः, एतन्माहात्म्य पठनश्रवणफलश्रुतिः ... - - - - - - - - --- --- ---
2.1.m: 10. Now, King Toṇḍamān's acquisition of the kingdom from his father; the news of Varāha communicated to King Toṇḍamān by Vasu; the king's going to Śeṣācala through a subterranean passage on the basis of the Niṣāda's words and a dream; the milk-bath, construction of ramparts, and other works performed by King Toṇḍamān on the word of the Lord; the māhātmya of the Asthisarovara lake; the account of the devotee named Bhīma born in the potter lineage in Kurvadhāman; the devotee named Bhīma of Kurvadhāman attaining Vaikuṇṭha along with his wife; King Toṇḍamān's attainment of similarity of form [with the Lord] by the grace of Śrīnivāsa; the statement of the fruits of reciting and hearing this māhātmya. [...]
11. Now, the destruction of great sin of Kāśyapa through bathing in the Svāmipuṣkariṇī; the exposition of duty spoken by Śākalya. [17]
12. Deliverance from hells such as Tāmisra through bathing in the Svāmipuṣkariṇī; the attainment of great hell for those who lack faith in the greatness of Svāmitīrtha. [19.1]
13. Now, the description of the deeds of Dharmagupta; the cessation of madness for Dharmagupta who bathed in Svāmitīrtha by the instruction of Jaimini. [20.1]

2.1.s: 14 sumatyākhyadvijavṛttāntaḥ, atha sumatyākhyadvijasya kirātīsaṅgānmahāpātakaprāptiḥ, sumatiṃ prati durvāsaḥkathitabrahmahatyāmuktyupāyaḥ, sumateḥ svāmipuṣkariṇīsnānādbrahmahatyāvimuktiḥ... 21 2
2.1.d: 14 सुमत्याख्यद्विजवृत्तान्तः, अथ सुमत्याख्यद्विजस्य किरातीसङ्गान्महापातकप्राप्तिः, सुमतिं प्रति दुर्वासःकथितब्रह्महत्यामुक्त्युपायः, सुमतेः स्वामिपुष्करिणीस्नानाद्ब्रह्महत्याविमुक्तिः... 21 2
2.1.m: 14. The account of the twice-born named Sumati; now, the acquisition of a grave sin by the twice-born named Sumati due to association with a Kirāta woman; the means of release from the sin of killing a brahmin spoken by Durvāsas to Sumati; Sumati's release from the sin of killing a brahmin by bathing in the Svāmipuṣkariṇī. [21.2]
15. Now, the māhātmya of Rāmakṛṣṇatīrtha; the manifestation of the Lord, pleased by the austerity of the great seer named Rāmakṛṣṇa. [22.2]

2.1.s: 16 atha veṅkaṭādrau jaladānapraśaṃsā, śrutadevapādodakasevanena hemāṅgasya jātismaraṇam, śrutadevadattapuṇyena hemāṅgasya godhikātvavimuktiḥ . 23 1
2.1.d: 16 अथ वेङ्कटाद्रौ जलदानप्रशंसा, श्रुतदेवपादोदकसेवनेन हेमाङ्गस्य जातिस्मरणम्, श्रुतदेवदत्तपुण्येन हेमाङ्गस्य गोधिकात्वविमुक्तिः . 23 1
2.1.m: 16. Now, the praise of the gift of water on Mount Veṅkaṭa; Hemāṅga's recollection of past births through drinking the water that washed the feet of Śrutadeva; Hemāṅga's release from the condition of being a lizard through the merit given by Śrutadeva. [23.1]
17. Now, the description of the sacred field of Veṅkaṭācala and other topics. [24.1]
18. Now, the description of the glory of Lord Veṅkaṭeśvara. [24.2]

2.1.s: 19 atha brahmādīnāṃ nairantaryeṇa śrīveṅkaṭācale sthitivarṇanam, śrīveṅkaṭācalārohaṇasamayānusaṃdhānakramaḥ, pāpavināśanākhyatīrthamāhātmyam, dṛḍhamatyākhyaśūdravṛttāntaḥ, dṛḍhamataye sumatyākhyavipraprakāśitakarmānuṣṭhānakramaḥ, śūdrasya vaidikakarmopadeśena sumatyanubhūtadurgatiḥ, athāgastyoktyā durgatyapanodārthaṃ sumaterveṅkaṭādrigamanam, sumateḥ pāpanāśanasnānena durgatyapanodanam, vaidikakarmānuṣṭhāturdṛḍhamaterdurgatiprāptyapanodanam 25 2
2.1.d: 19 अथ ब्रह्मादीनां नैरन्तर्येण श्रीवेङ्कटाचले स्थितिवर्णनम्, श्रीवेङ्कटाचलारोहणसमयानुसंधानक्रमः, पापविनाशनाख्यतीर्थमाहात्म्यम्, दृढमत्याख्यशूद्रवृत्तान्तः, दृढमतये सुमत्याख्यविप्रप्रकाशितकर्मानुष्ठानक्रमः, शूद्रस्य वैदिककर्मोपदेशेन सुमत्यनुभूतदुर्गतिः, अथागस्त्योक्त्या दुर्गत्यपनोदार्थं सुमतेर्वेङ्कटाद्रिगमनम्, सुमतेः पापनाशनस्नानेन दुर्गत्यपनोदनम्, वैदिककर्मानुष्ठातुर्दृढमतेर्दुर्गतिप्राप्त्यपनोदनम् 25 2
2.1.m: 19. Now, the description of Brahmā and others dwelling constantly on Mount Veṅkaṭa; the proper method of meditation at the time of ascending Mount Veṅkaṭa; the māhātmya of the sacred ford called Pāpavināśana; the account of the Śūdra named Dṛḍhamati; the order of performance of religious duties revealed to Dṛḍhamati by the brahmin named Sumati; the misery experienced by Sumati due to instructing a Śūdra in Vedic rituals; then, Sumati's going to Mount Veṅkaṭa for the dispelling of his misery on the word of Agastya; the dispelling of Sumati's misery through bathing in Pāpanāśana; the dispelling of the misery incurred by Dṛḍhamati, the performer of Vedic rituals. [25.2]

2.1.s: 20 atha pāpavināśanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam, bhadramatyākhyadaridradvijavṛttāntaḥ, bhadramateḥ kāminyā veṅkaṭādrigamanaprotsāhanakaraṇam, kāminīkathitabhūdānapraśaṃsā, bhadramataye bhūpradānātsughoṣasya sadgatiḥ, bhadramateḥ pāpanāśanatīre bhūdānārthaṃ veṅkaṭādrigamanam, bhūdānaprabhāveṇa bhadramaterbhagavatsākṣātkāraḥ. . ... 27 1
2.1.d: 20 अथ पापविनाशनतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, भद्रमत्याख्यदरिद्रद्विजवृत्तान्तः, भद्रमतेः कामिन्या वेङ्कटाद्रिगमनप्रोत्साहनकरणम्, कामिनीकथितभूदानप्रशंसा, भद्रमतये भूप्रदानात्सुघोषस्य सद्गतिः, भद्रमतेः पापनाशनतीरे भूदानार्थं वेङ्कटाद्रिगमनम्, भूदानप्रभावेण भद्रमतेर्भगवत्साक्षात्कारः. . ... 27 1
2.1.m: 20. Now the description of the māhātmya of Pāpavināśana tīrtha: the account of the poor twice-born named Bhadramati; the encouragement to go to Mount Veṅkaṭa given to Bhadramati by his beloved wife; the praise of the gift of land spoken by the wife; Sughoṣa's attainment of a good realm through the gift of land to Bhadramati; Bhadramati's journey to Mount Veṅkaṭa for receiving the gift of land on the bank of Pāpanāśana; the direct vision of the Lord attained by Bhadramati through the power of the gift of land. 27 1

2.1.s: 21 atha rāmānujākhyadvijavṛttāntaḥ, ākāśagaṃgātīre rāmānujatapastuṣṭabhagavadāvirbhāvaḥ, rāmānujākhyaviprakṛtabhagavatstutiḥ, rāmānujākhyaviprakṛtabhagavatprārthanā, bhagavadvarṇitākāśagagātīrthasnānakālaḥ, bhagavadvarṇita bhāgavata lakṣaṇāni... 29 1
2.1.d: 21 अथ रामानुजाख्यद्विजवृत्तान्तः, आकाशगंगातीरे रामानुजतपस्तुष्टभगवदाविर्भावः, रामानुजाख्यविप्रकृतभगवत्स्तुतिः, रामानुजाख्यविप्रकृतभगवत्प्रार्थना, भगवद्वर्णिताकाशगगातीर्थस्नानकालः, भगवद्वर्णित भागवत लक्षणानि... 29 1
2.1.m: 21. Now the account of the twice-born named Rāmānuja: the manifestation of the Lord pleased by the austerity of Rāmānuja on the bank of Ākāśagaṅgā; the praise of the Lord made by the vipra named Rāmānuja; the prayer to the Lord made by the vipra named Rāmānuja; the time for bathing in Ākāśagaṅgā tīrtha described by the Lord; the characteristics of a devotee of Bhagavān described by the Lord. 29 1

2.1.s: 22 dānārhasatpātranirṇayaḥ, ākāśagaṃgāmāhātmyam, puṇyaśīlasya vandhyāpatinimantraṇena gardabhamukhavattvaprāptiḥ vandhyāpateḥ śrāddhanimantraṇānarhatvakathanam, ākāśagaṃgāsnānena puṇyaśīlasya tadvikṛtinivṛttiḥ............... 30
2.1.d: 22 दानार्हसत्पात्रनिर्णयः, आकाशगंगामाहात्म्यम्, पुण्यशीलस्य वन्ध्यापतिनिमन्त्रणेन गर्दभमुखवत्त्वप्राप्तिः वन्ध्यापतेः श्राद्धनिमन्त्रणानर्हत्वकथनम्, आकाशगंगास्नानेन पुण्यशीलस्य तद्विकृतिनिवृत्तिः............... 30
2.1.m: 22. The determination of the worthy recipient fit for gifts; the māhātmya of Ākāśagaṅgā; Puṇyaśīla's acquisition of a donkey's face due to inviting the husband of a barren woman; the statement of the unfitness of the husband of a barren woman for invitation to a śrāddha; the cessation of Puṇyaśīla's deformity through bathing in Ākāśagaṅgā. 30

2.1.s: 23 atha cakratīrthamāhātmyam, padmanābhākhyadvijakṛtatapaḥprakāraḥ, cakratīrtheṃ padmanābhadvijakṛtatapastuṣṭabhagavadāvirbhāvaḥ, padmanābhākhyadvijakṛtaśrīnivāsastutiḥ, padmanābhasya cakratīrthe nirantaravāsāya bhagavanniyamanam, padmanābhahananodyatāsuravadhāya bhagavatkṛte cakrapreṣaṇam, bhagavatpreṣitacakrakṛtāsuravadhaḥ, dvijaprārthanayā cakrakṛtavaradānādiḥ.,..... -............ 31
2.1.d: 23 अथ चक्रतीर्थमाहात्म्यम्, पद्मनाभाख्यद्विजकृततपःप्रकारः, चक्रतीर्थें पद्मनाभद्विजकृततपस्तुष्टभगवदाविर्भावः, पद्मनाभाख्यद्विजकृतश्रीनिवासस्तुतिः, पद्मनाभस्य चक्रतीर्थे निरन्तरवासाय भगवन्नियमनम्, पद्मनाभहननोद्यतासुरवधाय भगवत्कृते चक्रप्रेषणम्, भगवत्प्रेषितचक्रकृतासुरवधः, द्विजप्रार्थनया चक्रकृतवरदानादिः.,..... -............ 31
2.1.m: 23. Now the māhātmya of Cakra tīrtha: the manner of austerity performed by the twice-born named Padmanābha; the manifestation of the Lord pleased by the austerity performed by the twice-born Padmanābha at Cakra tīrtha; the praise of Śrīnivāsa made by the twice-born named Padmanābha; the Lord's instruction to Padmanābha to reside perpetually at Cakra tīrtha; the dispatch of the discus by the Lord to slay the asura intent on killing Padmanābha; the slaying of the asura by the discus dispatched by the Lord; the granting of boons and other blessings by the discus upon the prayer of the twice-born. 31

2.1.s: 24 atha sundarākhyagandharvasya rākṣasatvaprāptinivṛttyorupodghātaḥ, sundarākhyasya vasiṣṭhoktarākṣasatvanivṛttyupāyaḥ, sundarākhyasya rākṣasatvavimuktipūrvakaṃ svasvarūpa prāptiḥ... ......... .... 32 2
2.1.d: 24 अथ सुन्दराख्यगन्धर्वस्य राक्षसत्वप्राप्तिनिवृत्त्योरुपोद्घातः, सुन्दराख्यस्य वसिष्ठोक्तराक्षसत्वनिवृत्त्युपायः, सुन्दराख्यस्य राक्षसत्वविमुक्तिपूर्वकं स्वस्वरूप प्राप्तिः... ......... .... 32 2
2.1.m: 24. Now the introduction to the attainment and removal of the state of a rākṣasa by the gandharva named Sundara; the means for removing the state of a rākṣasa spoken by Vasiṣṭha to the one named Sundara; Sundara's attainment of his own true form preceded by liberation from the state of a rākṣasa. 32 2

25. Now the description of the māhātmya of Jābāli tīrtha: the account of the twice-born named Durācāra residing on the bank of the Kāverī; the removal of the great sins and other defilements of Durācāra and the vetāla through bathing in Jābāli tīrtha; the declaration by Jābāli of the fault of not performing the pārvaṇa-śrāddha. 33 2

2.1.s: 26 atha tumbaru (ghoṇa) tīrthamāhātmyam, ghoṇatīrthasnānavimukhānāṃ mahādoṣavarṇanam, ghoṇasnānasya sarvapāpāpanodakavarṇanam, tuṃbarvākhyagandharvacaritam, svabhāryāyai tumbarūpadiṣṭamādhavasnānavidhiprakāraḥ, bhāryāṃ prati tumbarudattaśāpa tadvimuktiprakārau, ghoṇatīrthe'gastyadarśanena tumbarupatnyā varpābhūtvanivṛttiḥ, agastyakathitapativratādharmāḥ, ghoṇatīrthasnātṝṇāṃ nānāvidhaphalaprāptiḥ... 34 2
2.1.d: 26 अथ तुम्बरु (घोण) तीर्थमाहात्म्यम्, घोणतीर्थस्नानविमुखानां महादोषवर्णनम्, घोणस्नानस्य सर्वपापापनोदकवर्णनम्, तुंबर्वाख्यगन्धर्वचरितम्, स्वभार्यायै तुम्बरूपदिष्टमाधवस्नानविधिप्रकारः, भार्यां प्रति तुम्बरुदत्तशाप तद्विमुक्तिप्रकारौ, घोणतीर्थेऽगस्त्यदर्शनेन तुम्बरुपत्न्या वर्पाभूत्वनिवृत्तिः, अगस्त्यकथितपतिव्रताधर्माः, घोणतीर्थस्नातॄणां नानाविधफलप्राप्तिः... 34 2
2.1.m: 26. Now the māhātmya of Tumbaru (Ghoṇa) tīrtha: the description of the great fault of those averse to bathing in Ghoṇa tīrtha; the description of bathing in Ghoṇa as removing all sins; the life of the gandharva named Tumbaru; the method for the rites of the Mādhava bath instructed by Tumbaru to his wife; the curse given by Tumbaru to his wife and the manner of deliverance from it; the cessation of the frog-state of Tumbaru's wife through the sight of Agastya at Ghoṇa tīrtha; the duties of a devoted wife spoken by Agastya; the attainment of various fruits by those who bathe in Ghoṇa tīrtha. 34 2

2.1.s: 27 atha veṅkaṭācalasya sarvapuṇyatīrthādhāratvavarṇanam, svāmipuṣkariṇyādiṣaṭtīrthasnānakālanirṇayaḥ, purāṇaśravaṇasya viśeṣataḥ prāśastyavarṇanam, purāṇavaktuḥ sarvapūjanīyatvavarṇanam.. 36 2
2.1.d: 27 अथ वेङ्कटाचलस्य सर्वपुण्यतीर्थाधारत्ववर्णनम्, स्वामिपुष्करिण्यादिषट्तीर्थस्नानकालनिर्णयः, पुराणश्रवणस्य विशेषतः प्राशस्त्यवर्णनम्, पुराणवक्तुः सर्वपूजनीयत्ववर्णनम्.. 36 2
2.1.m: 27. Now the description of Mount Veṅkaṭa as the foundation of all holy tīrthas; the determination of the times for bathing in the six tīrthas beginning with Svāmipuṣkariṇī; the description of the preeminent excellence of listening to a Purāṇa; the description of the narrator of a Purāṇa as worthy of worship by all. 36 2

2.1.s: 28 kaṭāhatīrthamāhātmyam, kaṭāhatīrthamahimaśraddhāśūnyānāṃ janānāṃ mahānarakaprāptiḥ, kaṭāhatīrthapānakramaḥ, keśavākhyadvijavṛtāntaḥ, gaṇikālaṃpaṭasya keśavadvijasya brahmahatyāprāptikramaḥ, svasutarakṣaṇodyukte padmanābhe brahmahatyoktiḥ, padmanābhaṃ prati bhāradvājakathito brahmahatyāvimuktyupāyaḥ, bhāradvājoktyā kaṭāhatīrthapānena keśavasya brahmahatyāvimuktiḥ vrahmahatyāvimuktasutena sahitaṃ padmanābhaṃ prati bhagavaduktiḥ... 38 1
2.1.d: 28 कटाहतीर्थमाहात्म्यम्, कटाहतीर्थमहिमश्रद्धाशून्यानां जनानां महानरकप्राप्तिः, कटाहतीर्थपानक्रमः, केशवाख्यद्विजवृतान्तः, गणिकालंपटस्य केशवद्विजस्य ब्रह्महत्याप्राप्तिक्रमः, स्वसुतरक्षणोद्युक्ते पद्मनाभे ब्रह्महत्योक्तिः, पद्मनाभं प्रति भारद्वाजकथितो ब्रह्महत्याविमुक्त्युपायः, भारद्वाजोक्त्या कटाहतीर्थपानेन केशवस्य ब्रह्महत्याविमुक्तिः व्रह्महत्याविमुक्तसुतेन सहितं पद्मनाभं प्रति भगवदुक्तिः... 38 1
2.1.m: 28. The māhātmya of Kaṭāha tīrtha: the attainment of a great hell by people devoid of faith in the greatness of Kaṭāha tīrtha; the procedure for drinking from Kaṭāha tīrtha; the account of the twice-born named Keśava; the process of the twice-born Keśava, who was addicted to a courtesan, contracting the murder of a brahmin; the speech of the guilt of killing a brahmin to Padmanābha as he engaged in protecting his son; the means of deliverance from the murder of a brahmin spoken by Bhāradvāja to Padmanābha; the deliverance of Keśava from the murder of a brahmin through drinking from Kaṭāha tīrtha according to the word of Bhāradvāja; the Lord's speech to Padmanābha together with his son delivered from the murder of a brahmin. 38 1
29. Now the introduction to Arjuna's pilgrimage to sacred fords: Arjuna's journey to the Suvarṇamukharī preceded by bathing in the Gaṅgā and other tīrthas. 40 1

2.1.s: 30 atha suvarṇamukharīvarṇanam, arjunasya suvarṇamukharītīrasthakālahastīśvarādisevāprāptiḥ, arjunasya svarṇamukharītīrasthabharadvājāśramagamanam, arjunakṛtabharadvājasevākramaḥ, arjunaṃ prati bharadvājakṛtā''tithyasatkāraḥ.. 41 1
2.1.d: 30 अथ सुवर्णमुखरीवर्णनम्, अर्जुनस्य सुवर्णमुखरीतीरस्थकालहस्तीश्वरादिसेवाप्राप्तिः, अर्जुनस्य स्वर्णमुखरीतीरस्थभरद्वाजाश्रमगमनम्, अर्जुनकृतभरद्वाजसेवाक्रमः, अर्जुनं प्रति भरद्वाजकृता'ऽतिथ्यसत्कारः.. 41 1
2.1.m: 30. Now the description of the Suvarṇamukharī: Arjuna's attainment of service to Kālahastīśvara and others situated on the bank of the Suvarṇamukharī; Arjuna's journey to the hermitage of Bharadvāja on the bank of the Svarṇamukharī; the manner of honor rendered to Bharadvāja by Arjuna; the hospitable reception accorded to Arjuna by Bharadvāja. 41 1

2.1.s: 31 atha svarṇamukharīprabhāvaśuśrūṣayā bharadvājaṃ pratyarjunapraśnaḥ, bharadvājakathitaśaṃkaravivāhaprakriyā, bhūsāmyakaraṇāyāgastyasya himādrerdakṣiṇadiggamanam.. 42 1
2.1.d: 31 अथ स्वर्णमुखरीप्रभावशुश्रूषया भरद्वाजं प्रत्यर्जुनप्रश्नः, भरद्वाजकथितशंकरविवाहप्रक्रिया, भूसाम्यकरणायागस्त्यस्य हिमाद्रेर्दक्षिणदिग्गमनम्.. 42 1
2.1.m: 31. Now Arjuna's inquiry of Bharadvāja out of a desire to hear the power of the Svarṇamukharī; the story of Śaṃkara's marriage related by Bharadvāja; Agastya's journey from the Himālayas to the southern direction in order to balance the earth. 42 1

2.1.s: 32 atha nadyutpādanāyāgastyaṃ prati aśarīryuktiḥ, suvarṇamukharyutpādanāyāgastyaṃ prati maharṣiprārthanā, suvarṇamukharyāvirbhāvāyāgastyakṛtatapaḥprakāraḥ, agastyāśramaṃ prati caturmukhāgamanam, agastyaprārthanayā gaṃgāṃ prati caturmukhacodanā, agastyasamīpe svāṃśatvena gaṃgayā kṛto nadyutpattyabhyupagamaḥ........... 42 2
2.1.d: 32 अथ नद्युत्पादनायागस्त्यं प्रति अशरीर्युक्तिः, सुवर्णमुखर्युत्पादनायागस्त्यं प्रति महर्षिप्रार्थना, सुवर्णमुखर्याविर्भावायागस्त्यकृततपःप्रकारः, अगस्त्याश्रमं प्रति चतुर्मुखागमनम्, अगस्त्यप्रार्थनया गंगां प्रति चतुर्मुखचोदना, अगस्त्यसमीपे स्वांशत्वेन गंगया कृतो नद्युत्पत्त्यभ्युपगमः........... 42 2
2.1.m: 32. Now the incorporeal voice to Agastya for producing a river; the prayer of the great seers to Agastya for bringing forth the Suvarṇamukharī; the manner of austerity performed by Agastya for the manifestation of the Suvarṇamukharī; the arrival of the Four-faced One at the hermitage of Agastya; the urging of the Gaṅgā by the Four-faced One upon Agastya's prayer; Gaṅgā's consent given before Agastya to manifest as a river by a portion of herself. 42 2

2.1.s: 33 suvarṇamukharīṃ prati śakrādistutiḥ vāyukathitasuvarṇamukharīnāmaniṣpattiḥ, agastyakṛtasyānītasuvarṇamukharīmahimānuvarṇanam, bhāradvājavarṇitasuvarṇamukharīmāhātmyam, agastyapratimādānavidhiḥ.... 44 1
2.1.d: 33 सुवर्णमुखरीं प्रति शक्रादिस्तुतिः वायुकथितसुवर्णमुखरीनामनिष्पत्तिः, अगस्त्यकृतस्यानीतसुवर्णमुखरीमहिमानुवर्णनम्, भारद्वाजवर्णितसुवर्णमुखरीमाहात्म्यम्, अगस्त्यप्रतिमादानविधिः.... 44 1
2.1.m: 33. The hymn of praise to the Suvarṇamukharī by Śakra and the others; the derivation of the name Suvarṇamukharī spoken by Vāyu; the recount of the greatness of the Suvarṇamukharī brought by Agastya; the māhātmya of the Suvarṇamukharī described by Bhāradvāja; the procedure for giving an image of Agastya. 44 1

2.1.s: 34 athāgastyatīrthā'gastyeśvarayoḥ prabhāvaḥ, suvarṇamukharīsnānakālanirṇayaḥ devarṣipitṛtī rthamāhātmyam, veṇāsuvarṇamukharīsaṃgamavarṇanam suvarṇamukharyā vyāghrapadāhvayanadīsaṃgamaḥ, śaṃkhatīrthavarṇanam....... 45 2
2.1.d: 34 अथागस्त्यतीर्थाऽगस्त्येश्वरयोः प्रभावः, सुवर्णमुखरीस्नानकालनिर्णयः देवर्षिपितृती र्थमाहात्म्यम्, वेणासुवर्णमुखरीसंगमवर्णनम् सुवर्णमुखर्या व्याघ्रपदाह्वयनदीसंगमः, शंखतीर्थवर्णनम्....... 45 2
2.1.m: 34. Now the power of Agastya tīrtha and Agastyeśvara; the determination of the time for bathing in the Suvarṇamukharī; the māhātmya of the Devarṣipitṛ tīrtha; the description of the confluence of the Veṇā and the Suvarṇamukharī; the confluence of the Suvarṇamukharī with the river named Vyāghrapadā; the description of Śaṅkha tīrtha. 45 2

2.1.s: 35 atha suvarṇamukharyāḥ kalpānadīsaṃgamaḥ, suvarṇamukharītīrasthaśrīveṃkaṭācalavarṇanam, veṃkaṭācalavāsi bhagavadvaibhavavarṇanam, bhagavatkṛtabhūtasṛṣṭyādivarṇanam.. 46
2.1.d: 35 अथ सुवर्णमुखर्याः कल्पानदीसंगमः, सुवर्णमुखरीतीरस्थश्रीवेंकटाचलवर्णनम्, वेंकटाचलवासि भगवद्वैभववर्णनम्, भगवत्कृतभूतसृष्ट्यादिवर्णनम्.. 46
2.1.m: 35. Now the confluence of the Suvarṇamukharī with the Kalpā river; the description of Mount Śrīveṅkaṭa situated on the bank of the Suvarṇamukharī; the description of the glory of the Lord dwelling on Mount Veṅkaṭa; the description of the creation of beings and other acts performed by the Lord. 46
36. The manner of the uplift of the earth performed by the Boar; the description of the incarnation of the White Boar preceded by an account of the cosmic age. 48 1

2.1.s: 37 śaṃkhābhidhānanṛpavṛttāntaḥ, bhagavaduktyā śaṃkhanṛpasya śrīveṃkaṭācalāgamanam, bhagavaddarśanārthamagastyasya śrīveṅkaṭācalāgamanam, agastyaṃ prati guruvasvādyuktiḥ, agastyādikṛtaśrīveṅkaṭācalastharamyavastudarśanam..... - .... - - 49 2
2.1.d: 37 शंखाभिधाननृपवृत्तान्तः, भगवदुक्त्या शंखनृपस्य श्रीवेंकटाचलागमनम्, भगवद्दर्शनार्थमगस्त्यस्य श्रीवेङ्कटाचलागमनम्, अगस्त्यं प्रति गुरुवस्वाद्युक्तिः, अगस्त्यादिकृतश्रीवेङ्कटाचलस्थरम्यवस्तुदर्शनम्..... - .... - - 49 2
2.1.m: 37. The account of the king named Śaṅkha; the arrival of King Śaṅkha at Mount Śrīveṅkaṭa according to the Lord's word; the arrival of Agastya at Mount Śrīveṅkaṭa to obtain darśana of the Lord; the speech of the Guru, the Vasus, and others to Agastya; the viewing of delightful sights on Mount Śrīveṅkaṭa by Agastya and others. 49 2

2.1.s: 38 agastyaśaṃkhāditapastuṣṭasya bhagavata āvirbhāvaḥ brahmādiprārthanayā bhagavadgṛhītasaumyabhūta rūpaprakāraḥ, agastyaprārthanayā svarṇamukharīnadyā bhagavaddattasarvādhikatvaprāptiḥ, śaṃkhanṛpavarapradānapūrvakaṃ bhagavadantardhānam, bharadvājavarṇitaśrīveṅkaṭācalamāhātmyanirūpaṇam 50 2
2.1.d: 38 अगस्त्यशंखादितपस्तुष्टस्य भगवत आविर्भावः ब्रह्मादिप्रार्थनया भगवद्गृहीतसौम्यभूत रूपप्रकारः, अगस्त्यप्रार्थनया स्वर्णमुखरीनद्या भगवद्दत्तसर्वाधिकत्वप्राप्तिः, शंखनृपवरप्रदानपूर्वकं भगवदन्तर्धानम्, भरद्वाजवर्णितश्रीवेङ्कटाचलमाहात्म्यनिरूपणम् 50 2
2.1.m: 38 The manifestation of the Lord, pleased with the austerity of Agastya, Śaṅkha, and others; the manner in which the Lord assumed a gentle form at the request of Brahmā and others; the river Svarṇamukharī attaining preeminence granted by the Lord at the request of Agastya; the Lord's disappearance after granting boons to King Śaṅkha; the setting forth of the Veṅkaṭācala-māhātmya described by Bharadvāja. 50 2
39 The manner of the austerity performed by Añjanā for the sake of a son. 52 1
40 Determination of the proper time for ritual ablution in the Ākāśagaṅgā as spoken by Vyāsa; praise of the gifts to be made on Śrī Veṅkaṭācala as spoken by Vyāsa. 53 1.
